purpose: Train target-specific research models from measured North American maize trials before product inference registration.

targets.yield: Measured grain yield, normalized to t/ha using the dataset's documented moisture basis
targets.quality_factor: Measured harvest grain moisture percent; this is one quality/drying factor, not a grade or protein prediction
targets.phenology: Days from planting to silking, if labels exist; this is not optimal harvest timing
targets.harvest_operation: Observed harvest date/days after planting, only if actual dates exist; one example per site-season, never duplicate plot rows as independent operations

issue_cutoff: 30 days after recorded planting. Use only observations at or before that cutoff. Do not use full-season environment covariates, actual harvest date, grain weight, target-derived traits, row/replicate IDs, silking/anthesis outcomes, or late-season observed weather as predictors.
spatial_test: Ontario site codes excluded from fitting and model selection. Report separately if present; otherwise explicitly unavailable.
unit_of_independence: site-season; plots and genotypes are correlated, not independent test seasons
selection: Each target selected by validation mean site-season MAE. Test labels are used once for final scoring, not tuning. Keep all candidate scores.
product_gate: Saved artifact, schema, units, source hashes, domain bounds, training/test evidence and inference-reload checks required. Research-only results must be labeled. No field agronomy validation, calibrated future grade probability, causal crop-loss response or economically optimal harvest recommendation follows merely from fitting.
data_failure_rule: If actual planting metadata or any target is absent, do not fabricate it. Report that target's training as unavailable and use separately labeled existing regional research results only where applicable.
scope: No paid services, passwords, CPU neural fallback, trades or deployment. Simple mathematical baselines may fit locally. New neural training uses the existing selected A100 only.
